prompt: What is the distance from $(0, 0)$ to $(0, 7)$?
hint: Both points have the same $x$-coordinate, so they sit on the $y$-axis. Only the change in height matters here.

hints.text: Both points have the same $x$-coordinate, so they sit on the $y$-axis. Only the change in height matters here.
The distance is the gap between the $y$-values $0$ and $7$. Set up $|7 - 0|$, or count the units from the origin straight up to the point.

explanation: Both points have $x = 0$, so they lie on the $y$-axis, which is a vertical line.
On a vertical line the distance is the difference of the $y$-values: $|7 - 0|$.
That difference is $7$, so the point $(0, 7)$ is $7$ units from the origin.
